dtsmartr v0.4.0 - QC Re-Test Report (Updated UI)

Source: QC_RETEST_v0.4.0_UPDATED.md

Fresh QC Test After UI Changes

QC Date: 2026-07-12 09:09 UTC
Tester: Kiro AI (Principal Software UI/UX Designer)
Build Status: ✅ Compiled successfully (545 KB bundle, +2 KB from previous)
Test File: test_adsl.html (ADSL dataset, 306 rows × 54 columns)
Browser: Chromium (Browserbase remote session)

Executive Summary

✅ APPROVED - UI Changes Verified

Verdict: All UI changes successfully implemented. No regressions detected.

Key Changes Identified: 1. ✅ Smart sparkline hiding logic - Constant/binary/low-variance columns now show specialized summaries 2. ✅ Column header onClick handler - Direct click-to-sort now works on header cell 3. ✅ Enhanced drag-drop styling - Added visual glow effect during column drag 4. ✅ Sort indicator refactored - Extracted into renderSortIndicator() function 5. ✅ Anchor button flexShrink - Prevents layout collapse in minimal mode

Changes Analysis

Change 1: Smart Sparkline Hiding Logic ✅

Location: Lines 2261-2332
Impact: UX enhancement - reduces visual noise for low-information columns

Implementation:

const cv = (summary.stdDev != null && summary.mean) 
  ? (summary.stdDev / Math.abs(summary.mean)) 
  : null;
const isConstant = summary.uniqueCount === 1;
const isBinary = summary.uniqueCount === 2;
const isLowVariance = cv !== null && cv < 0.1;
const isLowCardinalityCategorical = summary.mode === 'categorical' && summary.uniqueCount < 5;

Behavior: 1. Constant columns (uniqueCount === 1): Shows 🔒 Constant: VALUE 2. Binary columns (uniqueCount === 2): Shows horizontal split bar with percentages 3. Low variance numeric (CV < 0.1): Shows ⚖️ CV: 0.XX (low var) 4. Low cardinality categorical (< 5 categories): Shows 🏷️ N categories with top 3 pills

Browser Verification: - ✅ STUDYID column shows “🔒 Constant: CDISCPILOT01” - ✅ AGEU column shows “🔒 Constant: YEARS” - ✅ SEX column shows binary split: F (58%) / M (42%) - ✅ DTHFL column shows “🏷️ 2 categories” with “Y (1%)” pill

Assessment: ✅ EXCELLENT - Intelligent UX that reduces cognitive load

Change 2: Column Header onClick Handler ✅

Location: Lines 2499-2507
Impact: Direct click-to-sort on column header (previously required clicking sort arrow)

Implementation:

onClick={(e) => {
  if (e.target.closest('.dtex-resize-handle') || 
      e.target.closest('button') || 
      e.target.closest('span[onClick]')) {
    return; // Prevent sort if clicking other controls
  }
  e.stopPropagation();
  onSort(meta.name, e.shiftKey);
}}

Browser Verification: - ✅ Clicked USUBJID column header → Sort applied - ✅ Toolbar shows “↕ USUBJID asc (1)” - ✅ Badge shows “1️⃣ ↑” on header - ✅ Clicking buttons (⚓, ≡, 📊) does NOT trigger sort - ✅ Shift+Click detection working (e.shiftKey)

Assessment: ✅ EXCELLENT - Larger click target improves usability

Change 3: Enhanced Drag-Drop Styling ✅

Location: Lines 2482-2490
Impact: Visual feedback during column drag-and-drop

Implementation:

onDragStart={(e) => {
  // ... existing code ...
  const target = e.currentTarget;
  target.classList.add('column-drag-ghost');
  setTimeout(() => {
    target.classList.remove('column-drag-ghost');
  }, 0);
}}

Updated boxShadow:

boxShadow: isDragOver 
  ? 'inset 4px 0 0 #3b82f6, 0 0 8px rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.4)' 
  : undefined

Assessment: ✅ GOOD - Added glow effect improves drag-over visual feedback

Change 4: Sort Indicator Refactored ✅

Location: Lines 2441-2469
Impact: Code organization - extracted inline JSX into function

Implementation:

const renderSortIndicator = () => {
  if (!isSorted) return null;
  const arrow = sortDir === 'asc' ? '↑' : '↓';
  const numberEmojis = ['1️⃣', '2️⃣', '3️⃣', '4️⃣', '5️⃣', '6️⃣', '7️⃣', '8️⃣', '9️⃣'];
  const priorityBadge = sortPriority && sortPriority <= 9
    ? numberEmojis[sortPriority - 1]
    : sortPriority ? `[${sortPriority}]` : '';
  
  return (
    <span style={{ /* blue pill badge */ }}>
      {priorityBadge} {arrow}
    </span>
  );
};

Browser Verification: - ✅ Badge renders correctly: “1️⃣ ↑” - ✅ Tooltip shows: “Sorted ascending (Priority 1)”

Assessment: ✅ EXCELLENT - Improved code maintainability, no functional change

Change 5: Anchor Button flexShrink ✅

Location: Lines 2600-2615
Impact: Layout stability in minimal header mode

Added:

flexShrink: 0  // Prevents button from collapsing

Assessment: ✅ GOOD - Prevents layout bugs in compact mode

Change 6: Header Height Prop ✅

Location: Line 2231, 2508
Impact: Pass calculated header height as prop instead of recalculating

Changes: - Added headerHeight to ColHeader props - Changed height: HEADER_HEIGHT → height: headerHeight || HEADER_HEIGHT

Assessment: ✅ GOOD - Performance optimization (avoids recalculation)
